'7' is OCR corruption of '1' in 102.00","affected_items":["074.jpg"]},{"id":"F2","description":"total_amount wrong on 077.jpg (should be 23.26 from 'Total (Inclusive of GST): 23.26')","evidence":"Field feedback marks 077 amount_correct=false; two 'Total' lines (Excluding/Inclusive) require taking the last one","affected_items":["077.jpg"]},{"id":"F3","description":"total_amount wrong on 078.jpg (grand total 92.80 scoring as incorrect)","evidence":"Field feedback: 078 amount_correct=false despite OCR showing clean 'Grand Total: 92.80' and 'Total: 92.80'","affected_items":["078.jpg"]},{"id":"F4","description":"date wrong on 034.jpg","evidence":"Receipt shows Date 09/03/2018 (3 March 2018) but prediction gave 2018-08-09; DD/MM/YYYY was misread or month/day swapped","affected_items":["034.jpg"]}],"root_causes":[{"id":"R1","description":"Keyword matcher treats OCR-corrupted number tokens as valid without any sanity check against nearby candidate values (subtotal, cash, payment)","maps_to":["F1"]},{"id":"R2","description":"Within a priority tier the extractor does not consistently pick the last valid, non-excluded keyword-bearing line, so ambiguous 'Total (Excluding …)' vs 'Total (Inclusive …)' pairs can select the wrong one","maps_to":["F2"]},{"id":"R3","description":"When a receipt contains BOTH 'Total' and 'Grand Total', the priority logic can short-circuit on the wrong tier or wrong occurrence; also the output amount string formatting may drift from the oracle convention for edge totals","maps_to":["F3"]},{"id":"R4","description":"Date regex assumes DD/MM/YYYY for all slash/dash dates and never cross-checks against receipt locale, causing day/month swaps when the day<=12","maps_to":["F4"]}],"skill_defects":[{"skill":"image-ocr","defect":"Receipt extraction section (added in current candidate) does not describe how to disambiguate multiple TOTAL lines using cross-validation with subtotal/cash/payment/rounded totals, and does not warn that OCR frequently corrupts leading digits (1→7, 0→O) in large totals.","supporting_feedback_ids":["F1","F2","F3"]},{"skill":"image-ocr","defect":"Date extraction guidance assumes DD/MM/YYYY ordering is unambiguous; it does not instruct the agent to resolve ambiguity via secondary signals (second date on receipt, filename ordering, printed day name, or by preferring interpretations where day>12 to lock the format for that receipt).","supporting_feedback_ids":["F4"]},{"skill":"image-ocr","defect":"The 'Critical Rules for Receipt Extraction' section lists keyword priority tiers but omits a tie-breaking rule for multiple same-tier matches (take LAST non-excluded match scanning top-to-bottom) and does not require a consistency check: chosen total should (approximately) equal subtotal+tax or match the cash-minus-change value when both are present.","supporting_feedback_ids":["F1","F2","F3"]},{"skill":"xlsx","defect":"xlsx guidance does not explicitly warn that monetary fields written as strings must preserve exact two-decimal formatting and must be stored as text cells (not numbers) to avoid Excel coercing '47.70' to 47.7; this is only mentioned in image-ocr and may be lost when the agent switches tools.","supporting_feedback_ids":["F3"]}],"repair_recommendations":[{"target_skill":"image-ocr","change_summary":"Add a 'Disambiguating multiple TOTAL candidates' subsection: after priority-tier filtering, if >1 candidate remains in the chosen tier, take the LAST non-excluded occurrence in reading order; then run a sanity check against other numeric anchors on the receipt (subtotal, cash tendered − change, rounded total). If the keyword-matched number is numerically inconsistent with these anchors by more than a small tolerance, fall back to the anchor-derived value. Document that OCR commonly corrupts a leading '1' into '7' or '/' and a leading '0' into 'O/Q', and show a short example."},{"target_skill":"image-ocr","change_summary":"Expand the date extraction subsection with an ambiguity-resolution rule: when a date matches DD/MM/YYYY and all of D,M ≤ 12, look for a second date occurrence on the receipt or textual month name to lock the order; otherwise default to DD/MM/YYYY (receipt locale) but record the alternative. Add a quick self-check: the parsed year must be plausible (e.g., 2015–2025 for typical receipt corpora) and month must be ≤12."},{"target_skill":"image-ocr","change_summary":"Strengthen the 'Critical Rules for Receipt Extraction' bullet list: (a) explicit priority tier definition with LAST-match tie-break, (b) exclusion keywords are applied before priority matching, (c) require the extracted amount to be re-formatted via f\"{val:.2f}\" and written as string, (d) require filename sort as pure string sort, (e) require per-image try/except so one failure never aborts the batch."},{"target_skill":"xlsx","change_summary":"Add a short 'Writing monetary strings' note: when a column must hold a formatted decimal string (e.g., '47.70'), set the cell value as a Python str and, if using pandas, use dtype='object' and ExcelWriter with openpyxl; avoid passing floats which Excel will re-format. Cross-reference image-ocr for the receipt use case."},{"target_skill":"image-ocr","change_summary":"Add a 'Common OCR confusions in receipts' quick table (0↔O/Q, 1↔l/I/7 at line start, 5↔S, 8↔B, '.'↔',') with a recommended post-OCR normalization step that only applies inside numeric-looking tokens, and a note never to apply it to keyword text."}],"confidence":0.62}
